==Description==
'''Not The Same''' is a sticker unlocked by reaching Level 35 of the premium track in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. At that Level, it cost {{Bunz|1,230}} or {{Robux|145}}. The total cost was {{Bunz|20,260}} or {{Robux|3,545}}.

==Appearance==
The sticker showcases the Level 4 Default [[Crook Boss]] fixing its tie. It plays a sound of a tiger snarl.

==Trivia==
*This sticker is a reference to the [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-are-not-the-same We Are Not The Same] meme, which features [[w:c:breakingbad:Gustavo Fring|Gustavo Fring]], a character from [[w:c:breakingbad:Breaking Bad (TV series)|Breaking Bad]].
